why: Jazzy approved a 'Real or fake?' game Reel to raise comments/shares; it replaces the Thursday (question) cut from the week of Nov 15. The question hook moves into the game.
owner_note: The performance-analyst may change anything in 'tunable' (one change per version, see .claude/agents/performance-analyst.md). Nothing in 'locked' may change without Jazzy.

hook.rule: Open on the device doing the impossible thing (or the strangest true fact), in big text from frame 0. No context before it.
hook.first_frame: Frame 0 shows the hook text and the device; it is the cover.

structure.note: the device in action + the impossible claim, <= 10 words
2-3 dated, sourced history beats (year, place, who)
why it can't work as told, or what it would take; one simple diagram
fictional program title card + spec sheet (invented numbers)
3 trials with escalating numbers; the last one works
final pull-back + one question for the comments, <= 10 words

cutdowns.rule: Each cut opens on its own hook in the first 3 s; never open a cut on a slow line or a title card.

style.rule: Alternate a test style every other film (2D styles only, ~45 min render on 2 cores). After 2 tests per style keep the winner as the anchor; drop styles that lose twice.

caption.first_line: the hook or the comment question, <= 10 words

posting.note: Adjust with analytics_get_best_time_to_post once 10+ Reels have data.

game.name: real_or_fake

structure.note: 'One of these is real.' + 3 numbered devices on screen from frame 0
3 device cards, ~4 s each: name, one-line claim, one number. One is a real, sourced invention/patent/experiment; two come from our fictional programs
REAL stamp on the true one with year + source line; FAKE stamps on the others naming the film they come from

game.rules: The real device must be in a FACTS.md with source + quote. The fake ones are labelled FAKE at the reveal. Caption first line = the question; never give the answer in the caption.
game.judge: comments, shares+saves and follows per 1k reach vs the normal cuts, after 3 game Reels

locked.facts: Every real-world claim is sourced in the film's FACTS.md (claim -> URL). The fictional program, specs and trials are invented and never attributed to real agencies, labs or people.
locked.never_list: plan/CONTENT_PLAN.md -> Never: real health/vaccine claims, real elections, real disasters blamed on a device, real named people as villains, club/brand logos.
locked.visuals: No logos, no player/celebrity photos, no AI video. Code-rendered films only.
locked.video: 1080x1920, H.264 + AAC, about -14 LUFS. Uploaded files under 20 MB (jsDelivr limit).
locked.gates: Reviewer PASS before scheduling. validate_media on every URL. Never double-book a slot.
locked.ask_jazzy: Changing the niche, renaming the handle, anything involving money, or a topic near the never-list.

history.summary: 90-120 s film, 8 slots, 4 cutdowns 15-35 s with one hook type each, board anchor + style tests
Thu slot = 'Real or fake?' game Reel (20-30 s); 3 cuts per film (real/number/stamp)
history.evidence: Jazzy's request; no review data yet
